key_dataflow_audit: Fault-free RegisterJointRecord and noisy RegisterFaultJointRecord have genuinely different tape, parent-step, payment and transition laws. The noisy integral identity is proved anew by source-mode recursion and then identifies the SAME supplied policy value. Record/payoff/child primitives are shared; the old fault-free expectation theorem is not used as an unsupported noisy law identity.

Both literal-program optimality modules directly consume original finite selector_optimal_against_all_causal. The source-specific mathematical work is Bellman domination, equality for exactly substrate.execute goal, and Model.fixedPoint_unique, with price*writeCost<=1. Old choice-based greedy existence is not substituted for the supplied compiled program.

P6 accounting uses the same literal tariff as the source reward. action_schedule_resource_viable directly consumes resourceViable_of_pointwise_cost_le_replenish for arbitrary actual action/mode words; actual_record_resource_viable proves recorded paid readout equals that schedule before reuse. No expected-cost envelope is mistaken for a realized pathwise reserve statement.

Original C6 consumer is actually called. Fault-free record purpose first reuses original objective identification after proved integral transport. Unknown-hazard purpose derives its own observation injectivity from actual birth/paid means and then constructs the original MechanismTeleologicalFaithfulness, rather than importing fault-free hfaith for a different type.

Literal child->P5 uses real successful recordStep evidence and source-derived inherited program/physical target, not caller-supplied seed validity. actual_mode_birth_enters_maintenance extracts actual repair mode and passes the SAME child into that existing source consumer.
Public root adds only RegisterFaultPurposeInformation and RegisterProgramOptimality imports; all other new modules are reachable transitively and preexisting imports remain.
boundaries_preserved: Finite parameterized reliable-register/protected-code source, declared stable independent mode/label laws and action/readout permissions remain model contracts.
Exact experiment means and epsilon<1 identify source parameters; no finite-sample estimator or executable inverse is established by this package.
Cost units are controlled writes only, with zero idle/fault-execution charge and no extra environment, copying or rebinding charge. Supply>=writeCost and initial>=0 are independent design conditions.
Finite record expectations tending to discounted optimum are not an infinite complete-record probability law; zero padding after finite horizon is explicit.
Actual successful-child maintenance is conditional one-generation carrier entry. Parent history/Bool addresses do not establish globally unique concurrent child IDs or infinite reproduction.
Total hazard makes probe means and registered objective vanish; no no-go for the all-indifferent purpose class or everlasting target health is inferred.
Books, general C1/UMC/P11 obligations and whole-theory closure remain open; this review authorizes no theorem-count promotion or scope reduction.
mutation_scope: Only this exclusive independent JSON and external review checker/logs; no source, exports, Git, GI or configuration changes.

documentary_precision_finding.correct_source_reading: The registered repair-then-fault tape has mass3/64. Its first literal controlled-write expenditure is1, priced charge is1/2 at price1/2, and discountedPayoff is1/2 (one birth minus priced charge, then zero fault payoff). positive_fault_transaction_witness proves the net discounted payoff, not literal payment1/2.
documentary_precision_finding.scope: Documentary-only wording correction. No Lean type/source hash changes. Root owns the correction and its subsequent commit; review remains bound to56c1 Lean blobs.
documentary_precision_finding.corrected_wording: At epsilon=1/4, cost=1 and price=discount=1/2, the actual program optimal values are 45/32 (healthy) and 33/32 (damaged). Two fixed non-oracle one-step policies have actual record values 0 and 3/8. A specified repair-then-fault tape with fair labels has mass 3/64 and discounted net payoff 1/2; its literal write expenditure is 1 (priced fee 1/2), and its failed stage remains. Failed births always remain None/count0; no sampling, retry or success selection occurred.
